name: Raoa Addons for Elementor
author: raoatech

sections.description:
Raoa Addons for Elementor is a lightweight and performance-focused addon pack containing free Elementor widgets. Build navigation menus, breadcrumb trails, post grids, Swiper-powered post, testimonial, and logo carousels, testimonials, dual headings, dual buttons, info boxes, logo grids, pricing tables, progress displays, team sections, tabs, Year counters, and animated text without unnecessary frontend overhead.

Typography Widgets

  • Dual Heading (Free) – Create responsive two-part titles with gradient, elegant, and outline styles.

Button Widgets

  • Dual Button (Free) – Build accessible paired actions in Diagonal Split, Center Icon Connector, and Text + Icon Contrast styles.

Content Widgets

  • Menu (Free) – Build flexible navigation layouts with Elementor controls.
  • Text Slider (Free) – Create lightweight animated text effects.
  • Info Box (Free) – Present services and features in classic, side-media, corner-accent, and glass-overlay card styles.

Media Widgets

  • Logo Grid (Free) – Display client and partner logos in classic, seamless-border, and featured Bento layouts.
  • Logo Carousel (Free) – Showcase client and partner logos using continuous marquee, center-focus, dual-row marquee, and perspective coverflow layouts.

Statistics Widgets

  • Progress Bar (Free) – Display skills and status data using classic, circular, floating-value, and capsule layouts.

Team Widgets

  • Team (Free) – Present team members, social links, profile details, alignment, and responsive spacing controls in four styles.

Testimonials

  • Testimonials (Free) – Showcase customer feedback in four display styles.
  • Testimonials Carousel (Free) – Present testimonial cards in a responsive Swiper carousel.

Pricing Widgets

  • Pricing Table (Free) – Present unlimited pricing plans as responsive cards with billing toggle or as a horizontally scrollable feature comparison matrix.

Layout Widgets

  • Split Tabs (Free) – Organize content in clean, interactive tab sections.

Utility Widgets

  • Breadcrumb (Free) – Display an automatically generated breadcrumb trail in two styles.
  • Year Counter (Free) – Display dynamic year values automatically.

Post Widgets

  • Posts (Free) – Display posts in responsive grids with numbered and previous/next pagination.
  • Posts Carousel (Free) – Present posts using a responsive Swiper carousel with navigation, pagination, autoplay, and loop controls.

Features

  • Seventeen free Elementor widgets
  • Responsive desktop, tablet, and mobile controls
  • Conditional style controls that only appear when relevant
  • Swiper 12 carousel integration
  • Reusable carousel navigation and pagination controls
  • Standard WordPress post pagination
  • Unlimited pricing plans with shared card and comparison-matrix data
  • Multiple post, testimonial, breadcrumb, and team layouts
  • Translation-ready and WordPress coding-standard-friendly output
  • Lightweight, maintainable, and developer-friendly architecture
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/raoa-addons-for-elementor directory, or install via WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen.
  3. Open Elementor and use the widgets.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. Elementor must be installed and activated.

Will this plugin affect site speed?

No. The plugin is designed with performance as a priority.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Started the version 1.0.3 development cycle.
  • Added a Progress Bar widget with Classic Skill Bars, Circular Dashboard, Floating Value Bars, and Capsule Status Bars layouts.
  • Added per-item colors, icons, status labels, responsive controls, accessible progress semantics, and viewport animations.
  • Update a category based widget show in readme file.

1.0.2

  • Added a responsive Testimonials Carousel using the existing testimonial card styles and shared Swiper controls.
  • Added a Dual Heading widget with three title presets, responsive layouts, typography, gradient, outline, shadow, hover, link, and underline controls.
  • Added a Dual Button widget with Diagonal Split, Center Icon Connector, and Text + Icon Contrast styles, conditional controls, dynamic links, and independent button styling.
  • Added an Info Box widget with four responsive layouts, conditional style controls, media, badges, icons, and call-to-action links.
  • Added a Logo Grid widget with Classic Equal Grid, Seamless Border Grid, and Featured Bento Mosaic layouts.
  • Added a Logo Carousel widget with Continuous Marquee, Center Focus Slider, Dual Row Opposite Marquee, and Perspective Coverflow layouts.
  • Added a Pricing Table widget with unlimited plans, shared pricing data, pricing-card and feature-comparison-matrix layouts, billing toggle, featured-plan priority styling, per-plan feature values, and responsive controls.
  • Finalized the 1.0.2 translation template, responsive controls, accessibility output, and WordPress.org release metadata.

1.0.1

  • Added Breadcrumb, Posts Carousel, Testimonials, and Team widgets.
  • Added two Breadcrumb layouts with conditional style controls.
  • Added reusable Swiper 12 carousel navigation, pagination, autoplay, loop, speed, and responsive gap controls.
  • Added standard numbered and previous/next pagination to the Posts widget.
  • Added component-specific Posts and Posts Carousel style sections.
  • Added responsive Team content alignment and element spacing controls.
  • Improved translation, escaping, responsive controls, and WordPress.org compatibility.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Add Menu, Split Tabs, Posts, Year Counter, and Text Slider widgets.
